A sterile aqueous suspension of a suitable strain or strains of influ- enza virus types A and B, either individually or mixed, grown in- dividually in embryonated hen eggs and inactivated so that they retain their antigenic properties. The stated amount of haemag- glutinin antigen for each strain present is usually 15 micrograms per dose. Suitable strains of influenza virus are those recom- mended by WHO.
